name: Slow Time Club
tagline: Block distracting apps. Make time for life.
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey everyone 👋 I’m Abid, one of the makers behind Slow Time Club. I’ve spent much of my career building digital products. As a product guy, you spend a lot of time thinking about what makes someone open an app and come back to it. With Slow Time Club, I wanted to ask a different question: What would we build if success meant someone putting their phone down?
